column1: # Packages the -race legs of ci/check_go.sh do not run (CHAOS-11413). The test legs still run each one once, without -race.
# Row: package<TAB>class<TAB>witness<TAB>reason. Key = path relative to the module root. Sorted (LC_ALL=C), no duplicates.
#   class none: no go statement, channel, select, sync, atomic, errgroup, os/exec, net, database/sql, signal, timer goroutine,
#     t.Parallel, dot import, cgo file or //export in the package's own files, no reflect import in its test files, no function
#     value passed as an argument to a call outside racescope's pureCallees, and none of the rest in any in-module package it
#     links (what the scan cannot model keeps a package in -race; CHAOS-11413 threat-model ruling); witness is -. Proven by
#     internal/cigates/racescope, which fails when a listed package (or anything it imports from this module) gains one.
#   class covered-by:<package>: the same proof, except that <package> (itself still in -race, never listed here) may hold the
#     concurrency, and witness names a Test function of <package> that drives it and is not compiled out of -race.
# A package leaves this file as soon as it needs a -race run. internal/providersync and internal/cigates/testshard stay in -race.
